tools.name: search_credentials
tools.description: Search provider credentials by provider name, payer, or credential type. Returns matching records with due date and status (current, with payer, action needed, lapsed).

tools.name: list_billing_at_risk
tools.description: List providers with a lapsed or missing credential or payer enrolment — the ones whose claims are denying or about to. Most urgent first.

tools.name: get_credentials_due
tools.description: List credentials and payer cycles due within the next N days (default 90), including CAQH attestations and re-credentialing packets.

tools.name: get_credentialing_summary
tools.description: Get the credentialing summary: totals for tracked credentials, action needed, lapsed with billing at risk, due in 30 days, and sitting with the payer.

tools.name: export_credentialing_report
tools.description: Export the full credentialing report as CSV text (provider, credential, due date, status, follow-up history).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search_credentials" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
